title: Maa's Daily Cycle 24 Hours + Morning Fog
description: The data pack increases the daily cycle to 24 hours and adds morning fog.
body:
Absurd version of data pack Maa's daily cycle.This data pack changes the daily cycle from 20 minutes to 24 hour (!!!) and adds fog at dawn. This data package may not be compatible with data packages that change time scales, but it should be compatible with all others. Fog at dawn Fog cleared Fog at moonlit sunset
